purpose: Document the pinned original Store deployment contract; this file is not a Store source or an installer configuration.

selection_evidence.primary: Exactly one of the two MainApp directories exists.
selection_evidence.fallback: When both or neither exist, the original Store inspects the running HMI process.
selection_evidence.unresolved: Record unknown; do not claim an ID7 or ID8 qualification without target evidence.
selection_evidence.component_eligibility: Per-component mguHmi, staged RHMI resources and dependency compatibility; a repository supporting both families does not make every app compatible with both.

shared.app_uid_source: The target MainApp registry entry; never copy a UID from another app or report.
shared.sdk_donor_source: The original Store's discovery on the target; no fixed donor UID or path.
success_evidence: registry id and version match the requested app
registry supplies the installed app UID
Store status lists the app and expected version
no unresolved pending_reboot or failed last_apply for that app
tile visibility verified when the app declares a tile
launch and required functionality observed separately

profiles.package_preparation: The original Store prepares an OAP package for MainApp; published npm and .mgu containers are normalized by the deploy tool.
profiles.completion: Use the original MainApp guard and Store status. A completed file upload is not app registration.

profiles.package_preparation: The original Store prepares npm-format package/ contents for MainApp-21; it validates and adapts flat OAP, source and .mgu containers locally.
profiles.completion: Live through the running MainApp-21 when supported, otherwise queued until the next head-unit start; the original deploy tool never bounces MainApp-21.
profiles.applet_id_policy: Keep or allocate from target applet evidence using the original Store; do not hardcode a value from a historical report.
